# InNetworkNeuromorphicProcessing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The embedding of neuromorphic computing elements directly within network infrastructure to perform distributed, real-time processing. Enables low-latency, localized intelligence in networks, a core objective of iNEST for scalable and responsive systems.
